notes: Added procedural sound effects using InitAudioDevice/CloseAudioDevice and LoadSoundFromWave. Built GenSweepSound helper that fills float32 PCM data with a linearly-swept sine wave and applies a simple amplitude envelope. Sounds: sndFlap (400→700 Hz, 0.08s), sndScore (880→1200 Hz, 0.12s), sndDie (440→180 Hz, 0.35s). Had to read audio_raw_stream.c example to understand sample format (float32, mono). Had to check raylib.h for Wave struct layout (frameCount, sampleRate, sampleSize, channels, data) and LoadSoundFromWave signature.
